question: Does the ground-return median float on grass at the control marks the gen1 datum rests on, and by how much relative to open ground generally?

inputs.role: the marks the adopted gen1 constant is measured from

params.name: radius_m
params.why: disc within which returns are taken; matches the tie estimator's own pipeline-scale radius so the statistic describes the ties' own support

params.name: ground_source
params.why: the source those ties used; measuring the lift on a DIFFERENT ground source would not describe them

params.name: detrend
params.why: without it terrain slope inside the disc masquerades as vertical spread

params.name: reference_open_upland_mm
params.why: the other session's gen1-internal open-upland figure, for comparison; their statistic is PER CELL and this one is per disc, so the two are indicative rather than strictly like-for-like

columns.n_ground: vendor class-2 returns within radius_m, count
columns.p50_p10_mm: median minus 10th percentile of the DETRENDED return residuals, mm -- a spread, NOT a bias
columns.p95_p05_mm: 95th minus 5th percentile of the same, mm

headline: median p50-p10 40.9 mm at the datum's marks against 60.2 mm for open upland generally
